instruction: Change the background to purple on all slides in the presentation. I need to figure out how to do this for all slides simultaneously.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Change all slide backgrounds to purple color (RGB: 128, 0, 128). Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric which calculates the distance between actual and expected RGB values. The evaluator checks if all slides have purple background instead of the original white background. No custom functions needed as we reuse existing evaluator logic.
